[7] «Mas Ysa | Mas Ysa is the stage name of Thomas Arsenault, an artist.  A native of Montreal, Mas Ysa began writing electronic music in high school while living in São Paulo, Brazil and later attended the Oberlin Conservatory of Music where he studied Modern Composition.
